findings.message: Entry param busca (filter:pessoasEquipe, persisted) has no state in the definition. Added the public persisted state busca (string | null); qryPessoasEquipe(busca?, page, append) publishes it and sends it in the query input.

selectedMembroEquipe (select:cadastroPessoa) has no request that fetches the record and no setter. Added public selectMembroEquipe(id | null) that resolves the row of the loaded list, fills the edit draft and publishes client.selectionInvalid when the id is not found; added the getter cadastroPessoa that returns the selected row.

Commands cmdCadastrarPessoa and cmdSalvarAlteracoes have typed fields but no <command>.input state. Added the drafts cmdCadastrarPessoaDraft and cmdSalvarAlteracoesDraft with setCmdCadastrarPessoaDraft and setCmdSalvarAlteracoesDraft.

cmdCadastrarPessoa returns the new person but the list pessoas is filtered by busca, paged and sorted by name by the backend. The new person is only upserted by id (appended at the end of the loaded items) and may not match the current search or position; the page can call qryPessoasEquipe to reload.
